name: KNIT 360 Credit Note
description: FR-SALES-006 / FR-SALES-007 - Returns and Credit Memos. A sale reduced or given back. Posts, so it submits.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Who the money is being given back to.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: The company issuing the credit note.

fields.label: Against Sales Invoice
fields.description: The invoice this credits. Named, the credit reduces what that invoice still owes; left blank, it sits as a balance in the customer's favour to set against a later invoice.

fields.label: Posting Date
fields.description: The date this lands in the books.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why the credit is being given. Required: a credit note with no reason is the one an auditor asks about.

fields.label: Credit To
fields.description: The receivable account this credits, taken from the invoice it adjusts so the credit lands where the debt was put.

fields.label: Business Status
fields.description: Where this document has got to. Moved with the buttons at the top of this form, never typed.

fields.label: Net Total
fields.description: Sum of the line amounts, before tax.

fields.label: Tax Template
fields.description: Rates applied to the net total. The tax charged on the original sale is given back with it.

fields.label: Total Taxes
fields.description: Tax given back with the credit.
